screens.title: Search settings
screens.notes: Top app bar holds a single search text field with placeholder "Search settings" and a clear (X) button. Results list: each row shows the preference title, a breadcrumb line "Category > Group" and the preference subtitle; tapping opens that settings screen scrolled to the preference. Empty state shows "No results found".

screens.notes: App theme row: a segmented button row (System / Light / Dark) above a horizontally scrolling row of theme preview cards (mini app mockups) with the theme name under each; selected card has a check badge. "Dynamic" (Monet) only on Android 12+. Pure black switch is disabled when theme mode is Light. Changing tablet UI / start screen shows a "Requires app restart to take effect" toast. Search toolbar action exists on every SearchableSettings screen in two-pane mode only; listed for completeness.

screens.title: App language
screens.notes: Plain list of languages. First row "Default" (follow system), then every locale from locales_config sorted by display name. Each row: headline = language name in its own locale, supporting text = name in current locale; trailing primary-coloured check icon on the active language. Tapping applies immediately.

screens.title: Subtitles
screens.notes: Each row opens an edit-text dialog with an explanatory line under the title: language = "Subtitle language(s) to be selected by default on a video with multiple subtitles, Two- or three-letter languages codes work. Multiple values can be delimited by a comma."; whitelist = "Whitelist for subtitles. If a whitelist is defined, the first subtitle that contains a whitelisted word will be used. Multiple values can be delimited by a comma."; blacklist = "Blacklist for subtitles. If a blacklist is defined, all subtitles that contains a blacklisted word will be filtered out. Multiple values can be delimited by a comma.". Invalid language codes show "Invalid code: "xx"" under the field.

screens.notes: Audio language row opens an edit-text dialog with info line "Audio language(s) to be selected by default on a video with multiple audio streams, Two- or three-letter languages codes work. Multiple values can be delimited by a comma.". Boost cap subtitle shows the raw number.

screens.title: Edit custom buttons

dialogs.title: Delete button
dialogs.text: Do you wish to delete the button "Button"?

screens.empty: You have no custom buttons. Tap the plus button to create a custom button.
screens.notes: Reorderable list of custom player buttons (Lua). Each item is an outlined card: drag handle + button title on top row; bottom row has a star toggle (filled = primary/favourite button shown in player), edit (pencil) and delete (trash) icon buttons. Extended FAB bottom-right "Add". Edit dialog title row also shows "(ID: 1)". Title field errors: "Button already exists!" / "*required". Lua content fields are multi-line monospace.

screens.title: Script editor

dialogs.title: Delete file
dialogs.text: Do you wish to delete the file "file"?

screens.empty: Directory contains no items. Tap the plus button to add a new file.
screens.notes: App bar title is a dropdown selector switching between "Scripts" (lua files) and "Script options" (conf files). Body: list of files, each row has a type icon (lua = code icon, conf = settings icon), file name, and a trailing "..." button expanding a menu with "Rename file" and "Delete file". Tapping a file opens the code editor. FAB "+" adds a file. Filename errors: "File already exists", "Invalid filename".

screens.title: file.lua

dialogs.title: Warning
dialogs.text: You have unsaved changes. Do you still wish to go back?

screens.notes: Reached by tapping a file in the mpv script editor (not via a settings link). Title = file name. Full-screen monospace code editor with line numbers and Lua/conf syntax highlighting. Save action enabled only after modification; back with unsaved changes shows the warning dialog.

screens.title: Torrent

dialogs.title: Legal Notice
dialogs.text:
TorrServer relies on peer to peer file sharing to access content. By doing so, you also upload files to others. Any content you share is your sole responsibility.

No further notices will be issued.

screens.notes: Notice dialog shown the first time torrents are enabled. All other rows disabled while torrents are off; proxy URL also disabled when proxy mode is None. Port dialog info "Enter 0 to let system choose a port", error "Port must be a number between 0 and 65535". Trackers is a multi-line edit (subtitle shows first two lines + "..."); default is a 26-line tracker list. Reset is enabled only when trackers differ from default. Proxy URL dialog info "Supports http, https, socks4, socks4a, socks5, socks5h".

Edit MPV input file for keyboard mapping configuration

screens.notes: mpv.conf and input.conf rows open a multi-line monospace text editor dialog; value is also written to the corresponding file in the mpv config dir.

screens.title: Tracking

items.title: Open track menu on adding to library
Update progress when marked as read/watched
One-way sync to update the chapter progress in external tracker services. Set up tracking for individual entries from their tracking button.
Provides enhanced features for specific sources. Entries are automatically tracked when added to your library.

screens.notes: Tracker rows: leading tracker logo in a rounded square, tracker name, trailing green check icon when logged in. Tap logs in (OAuth in browser for MAL/AniList/Shikimori/Simkl/Bangumi; username/email + password dialog for Kitsu (Email) and MangaUpdates (Username)), or opens the logout dialog when logged in (logout button is error-coloured, both buttons fill width). Login dialog has a close (X) icon in the title row and a password visibility toggle. Enhanced trackers are only listed if a matching source is installed; otherwise the info text appends "Available but source not installed: Komga, Kavita". Help action opens the tracking guide in a browser.

screens.title: Data and storage

items.title: Used for automatic backups, chapter downloads, and local source.

You should keep copies of backups in other places as well. Backups may contain sensitive data including any stored passwords; be careful if sharing.

Last automatically backed up: Today
Clear episode/chapter cache on app launch

screens.notes: Backup row is a full-width two-segment button: "Create backup" (opens Create backup screen) | "Restore backup" (opens a file chooser, then the Restore backup screen). Storage usage row shows a progress bar of used/total disk space with the text above. "Storage" (with storage icon) opens the Storage tab (outside settings). Export opens a checkbox dialog (Type/Author/Artist require Title), then a CSV save picker (aniyomi_library.csv). Help action opens the storage FAQ.

screens.title: Create backup

items.title: Include sensitive settings (e.g., tracker login tokens)

screens.notes: Rows are labeled checkboxes inside section cards (titles Library / Settings / Extensions). Chapters, tracking, history and non-library entries are disabled unless Entries is checked; private settings disabled unless app or source settings are checked. A full-width "Create" button is pinned at the bottom (opens a save-file picker). On MIUI with optimization disabled a warning banner "Backup/restore may not function properly if MIUI Optimization is disabled." is shown on top.

screens.title: Restore backup
screens.notes: Checkboxes in one section card, full-width "Restore" button pinned at the bottom. If the backup is incomplete an extra card lists "You may need to install any missing extensions and log in to tracking services afterwards to use them." plus missing sources ("Missing sources:") and trackers ("Trackers not logged into:"); invalid files show "Invalid backup file:" with the error.

screens.notes:
Onboarding guide opens the onboarding flow (outside settings); manage notifications opens the system notification settings. Reset user agent enabled only when the UA differs from default. Hardware bitmap threshold options are device-dependent multiples of 1024 (first = device max, marked default) and the row is disabled if the device limit <= 2048. "Private" installer is hidden on release builds; Package installer is hidden on MIUI. Data saver children: server + B/W only for Bandwidth Hero, image format disabled for reSmush.it, others disabled when Disabled. Image format subtitle switches to "The Jpeg file size is considerably smaller then Webp is(meaning more data is saved), but it makes the images lose more quality as well.
Currently compresses to Jpeg" when on.

screens.title: Backup file schema

Each 56dp row: source icon, source name (bodyMedium) with "12 non-library entries in database" below, trailing checkbox; selected rows get a tinted background.
